name: Compass
summary: Shopify app that joins Meta ad spend with real store sales to show blended ROAS per campaign, answers plain-English questions about your ads and products (Ask Compass) and sends a weekly report with suggested actions. One plan with every feature.
best_for: Shopify merchants who spend on Meta ads and want one simple view of which campaigns turn into real store sales, with plain-English answers instead of Ads Manager reports
skip_if: your ad budget runs mostly through Google, TikTok or other channels, or you are not comfortable giving a new app broad access to store and customer data
honest_knock: It covers Meta ads only. The app asks for broad store access, including edit access to customers, products and orders, for what is an analytics tool. The privacy policy names OpenAI among the services that receive your inputs, and the terms allow usage limits at the developer's discretion. Compass launched in May 2026 and had 3 reviews on the listing when we read it, and no refund policy is published.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Compass · per month, one plan with every feature, billed in USD every 30 days through the Shopify App Store
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-27 on the Compass listing in the Shopify App Store; the terms and privacy policy were read on 2026-10-15) Compass has a single plan with every feature included: $49 a month, or $490 a year, which the listing says saves 17%. There is a 14-day free trial and no free plan. The listing says all charges are billed in USD, every 30 days, through Shopify. Compass's site adds that there are no setup fees and that you can cancel at any time. We found no published refund policy, and no stated limit on Ask Compass questions, stores or ad accounts; the terms do say the AI assistant is for reasonable business use and that usage limits may be imposed. Re-read on 14 November 2026 with a plain fetch of the Shopify App Store listing: $49 a month or $490 a year ("save 17%"; $490 against twelve months at $49, which is $588, is 16.7% off), one plan with every feature, 14-day free trial, billed in USD every 30 days through Shopify. Unchanged. Compass's own site also has a page at thecompassapp.io/pricing-plans with tiered plans by ad spend in another currency; the site menu does not link it and it contradicts the listing, so we do not use it as the price (see the buyer questions).

schema_offer.description: Compass, one plan with every feature, billed in USD every 30 days through the Shopify App Store; $490 a year on annual billing; 14-day free trial. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-14.

compare_with.name: Helm
compare_with.why: Helm, which the Shopify App Store now lists under the name GrowGiant, is in our dossiers as a broader Shopify business-intelligence app: on 4 October 2026 its single Operator plan was $129 a month or $1,299 a year. Compass is narrower and cheaper at $49 a month: it is built around Meta ad spend against store sales, with an AI assistant for questions

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Compass on a Shopify development store, but the core action was blocked by a card wall and the need for a separate Meta ad account. Only the install permissions, the welcome screen, the plan choice with Monthly and Annual, the Shopify Approve subscription screen with Approve greyed out, the cancellation FAQ and the uninstall dialog were seen, after which the app was uninstalled. No ROAS was seen and nothing was paid. Install: the install form on the App Store was sent at about 13:17 in our own tab; the first attempt only led to the list of installed apps, the second showed the dialog Install app, asking for View customer data (Sensitive data, device and activity data), View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Customers, products, orders, store analytics), which was approved. The app opened at about 13:19 without an account, password, demo or call. The listing is Compass by OptyDigitals, a Meta ads ROAS app for Shopify. Core action NOT DONE: the app shows nothing useful before a plan is chosen. The first screen Welcome to Compass says the 14-day trial only starts after you subscribe and its only button is Choose your plan. The core of the app, blended ROAS per Meta campaign, needs the step Connect Meta, which is a separate Meta ad account outside the store, and the development store has no Meta ads. The plan could not be started either, because the Shopify approval screen needed a payment method (a card wall). No ROAS, no campaign view, no Ask Compass answer and no weekly report was seen, and the time to a first result could not be measured. Plans: the page Choose your plan says Unlock Compass with monthly or annual billing. New stores get one 14-day free trial per shop. Compass Monthly is $49 / month (Flexible month-to-month billing.) and Compass Annual is $490 / year ($41/month billed annually, Save 17% vs monthly); both cards list the same six features (Know what ads to scale or pause, Ask questions, get clear answers, See your true ROAS from sales, Get clear actions to improve results, Spot wasted ad spend early, See what your ads are driving) and both buttons say Start free trial. The pound plans Starter, Growth and Pro from the vendor site did not appear in the app. A FAQ under the plans covers billing, cancellation and about Compass. Checkout: Start free trial was clicked for Monthly. The Shopify screen Approve subscription showed the plan Compass Monthly, $49,00 USD every 30 days, You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., a subtotal of $49,00 plus any applicable taxes, a total of $49,00 due 1 Dec and the row Add payment method; the button Approve stayed greyed out without a payment method. The line You will not be billed for this test charge was NOT on the screen, so nothing was approved and no card was entered. The Cancel button did not react, so the app was opened again through the menu. Cancelling: the FAQ How do I cancel? says to open Pricing or Settings in Compass and use Cancel subscription, or to manage the charge in the Shopify admin under Apps. There was no subscription, so nothing could be cancelled. The uninstall dialog Uninstall Compass? (Settings, Apps, menu) says you will no longer be able to use the app, that data managed by the app will be deleted and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete personal customer information; a reason is required and the Uninstall button stays grey until one is chosen (Testing multiple apps). The app was uninstalled at about 13:22 and is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: connecting Meta, blended ROAS, Ask Compass, the weekly report, any Google or TikTok support (not visible without a subscription), and whether Compass changes nothing in the ads. Clean up: the app was uninstalled; no subscription was approved, no payment method was entered and no theme change was made. Other apps were not touched. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app shows nothing but a welcome screen and a plan choice before a plan is started, the Approve button stays greyed out without a payment method and the test charge line was missing, the Cancel button on the approval screen did not react, the first install attempt only led to the list of installed apps, and the vendor site shows pound plans that the app does not.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Compass on a Shopify development store, but the core action was blocked by a card wall and the need for a separate Meta ad account. Only the install permissions, the welcome screen, the plan choice with Monthly and Annual, the Shopify Approve subscription screen with Approve greyed out, the cancellation FAQ and the uninstall dialog were seen, after which the app was uninstalled. No ROAS was seen and nothing was paid. Install: the install form on the App Store was sent at about 13:17 in our own tab; the first attempt only led to the list of installed apps, the second showed the dialog Install app, asking for View customer data (Sensitive data, device and activity data), View staff and contributor data (Store owner) and View and edit store data (Customers, products, orders, store analytics), which was approved. The app opened at about 13:19 without an account, password, demo or call. The listing is Compass by OptyDigitals, a Meta ads ROAS app for Shopify. Core action NOT DONE: the app shows nothing useful before a plan is chosen. The first screen Welcome to Compass says the 14-day trial only starts after you subscribe and its only button is Choose your plan. The core of the app, blended ROAS per Meta campaign, needs the step Connect Meta, which is a separate Meta ad account outside the store, and the development store has no Meta ads. The plan could not be started either, because the Shopify approval screen needed a payment method (a card wall). No ROAS, no campaign view, no Ask Compass answer and no weekly report was seen, and the time to a first result could not be measured. Plans: the page Choose your plan says Unlock Compass with monthly or annual billing. New stores get one 14-day free trial per shop. Compass Monthly is $49 / month (Flexible month-to-month billing.) and Compass Annual is $490 / year ($41/month billed annually, Save 17% vs monthly); both cards list the same six features (Know what ads to scale or pause, Ask questions, get clear answers, See your true ROAS from sales, Get clear actions to improve results, Spot wasted ad spend early, See what your ads are driving) and both buttons say Start free trial. The pound plans Starter, Growth and Pro from the vendor site did not appear in the app. A FAQ under the plans covers billing, cancellation and about Compass. Checkout: Start free trial was clicked for Monthly. The Shopify screen Approve subscription showed the plan Compass Monthly, $49,00 USD every 30 days, You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., a subtotal of $49,00 plus any applicable taxes, a total of $49,00 due 1 Dec and the row Add payment method; the button Approve stayed greyed out without a payment method. The line You will not be billed for this test charge was NOT on the screen, so nothing was approved and no card was entered. The Cancel button did not react, so the app was opened again through the menu. Cancelling: the FAQ How do I cancel? says to open Pricing or Settings in Compass and use Cancel subscription, or to manage the charge in the Shopify admin under Apps. There was no subscription, so nothing could be cancelled. The uninstall dialog Uninstall Compass? (Settings, Apps, menu) says you will no longer be able to use the app, that data managed by the app will be deleted and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete personal customer information; a reason is required and the Uninstall button stays grey until one is chosen (Testing multiple apps). The app was uninstalled at about 13:22 and is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: connecting Meta, blended ROAS, Ask Compass, the weekly report, any Google or TikTok support (not visible without a subscription), and whether Compass changes nothing in the ads. Clean up: the app was uninstalled; no subscription was approved, no payment method was entered and no theme change was made. Other apps were not touched. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app shows nothing but a welcome screen and a plan choice before a plan is started, the Approve button stays greyed out without a payment method and the test charge line was missing, the Cancel button on the approval screen did not react, the first install attempt only led to the list of installed apps, and the vendor site shows pound plans that the app does not.
